title: Microsoft Graph Beta Copilot Admin API — Access, Permissions & Troubleshooting Runbook
author_notes: pricing: T2/T3 - focused single-API-family troubleshooting runbook (branch-based diagnostic method + 5 read-only Graph scripts). Anchor 1995.00 sits at the T2/T3 boundary, consistent with single-platform Copilot solutions.

gov_variant: false. The Copilot admin beta endpoints (catalog/packages, policySettings) are Global-only per their national-cloud tables (US Gov L4, US Gov L5/DoD, 21Vianet all show unavailable). There is therefore no distinct Government CONFIGURATION to author; instead the Gov difference IS the finding - documented inline (Requirements R6, Runbook Branch F): in GCC High/DoD the endpoint does not exist and the supported fallback becomes primary. All 5 scripts expose -Environment Global|USGov|USGovDoD to target graph.microsoft.us / dod-graph.microsoft.us for the fallbacks. GCC High specifics flagged 'verify against current Microsoft documentation'.

ACCURACY: all endpoint paths, permission scopes, admin roles, license requirements, error semantics, and cloud-availability facts verified against Microsoft Learn on 2026-07-24 - Package Management API overview + copilotpackages-list + copilotpackagedetail-get, copilotpolicysetting-get, Copilot APIs overview, Copilot APIs security-authentication, Graph permissions reference (CopilotPackages), Graph throttling + national-cloud deployments, plus Microsoft Q&A threads confirming the app-only-token 403 'user context is required' behavior and tenant-by-tenant flighting. Beta behavior flagged volatile throughout ('verify against current Microsoft documentation - beta, subject to change').

Key verified specifics: catalog/packages requires DELEGATED context (app-only tokens rejected with 403 'User context is required') despite the reference listing Application permissions; policySettings Application = Not supported; scopes CopilotPackages.Read.All / CopilotPolicySettings.Read; least-priv role AI Administrator; current docs now require a Microsoft Agent 365 license for the package API (changed from original 'no additional license required' announcement).
Customer already RULED OUT Agent 365 licensing as the blocker - runbook Branch G confirms and excludes licensing, then moves on to the real causes.

DEDUPE boundary: sibling product copilot-agent-builder-inventory-sharing-governance-export (AGBINV) owns the agent INVENTORY + SHARING EXPORT deliverable and a short diagnostic. THIS product (CPADMDX) is the deep, general troubleshooting runbook for the /beta/copilot/admin/* API surface itself - broader than one export task; it references AGBINV for the export rather than reproducing it.
